controller.front_label: Newport Motion Controller / Driver - Model HXP

interpretation: GPIO1.DO is live at raw value 4, matching the legacy LabVIEW GPIO1.DO mask-4 state-marker evidence.
GPIO3.DO and GPIO4.DO were both low in this single snapshot; this does not establish Pockels polarity.
GPIO2.DAC1 was 10.0000 in the live controller snapshot, so the old TCL 1-5 values must not be treated as the complete present-day analogue output range or as calibrated optical power.

notes: The LX13 connector is visibly populated on the PHAROS.
A D-sub cable is visibly plugged into HXP GPIO3, which is consistent with the later LabVIEW-v3 GPIO3.DO Pockels candidate.
The photographs do not provide an unambiguous continuous cable trace proving that the populated HXP GPIO3 cable is the same cable reaching PHAROS LX13.
The front label 'Model HXP' identifies the controller chassis, not the mechanical hexapod stage model.
